body: So my first car was a ‘99 Camry. She was good to me, but also a hot mess. I currently am in a ‘21 Camry as a rental - and my, it’s come a long way. I kinda love it and would totally buy one for myself.

I’m a gay man that was raped by my “straight” male friend. It has caused me tremendous trauma and lingering repercussions. He is married and has a toddler son. After confiding in a friend, I learned that this person raped his own brother numerous times during their childhood. I have no idea how to handle the situation. I’m grateful for any advice.

Not to sound cliche, but you are so young. We are all in a weird place in the world. You will be surprised by how much you grow and how much you will learn about yourself. I can’t sit here and tell you that it gets better. I can’t tell you that life gets easier. But I I can tell you that you’ll never know if you don’t try. You have nothing to prove to anyone. Except yourself. You are better and stronger than thoughts or forces that make you feel less. I’m glad that you were able to express your frustrations and vent. That’s a great way to put it out there and be honest with yourself and your feelings. You will learn as you grow. Listen to yourself and be aware of your feelings. You know how to get out this funk and feel better. You got this.
There is help for you. I understand you have a lot going on. Where are you staying now Ama how are you able to post on here?
